facts.fact: 边缘农民申诉：猎物锐减、动物像在逃命——她早知道此事，Walder 眼角的紧绷说明他早知且深忧
facts.anchor: Farmers from the very edges of Arelia, reporting that game in the forests had decreased significantly

facts.fact: 她偷藏宫廷 valuables 想寄回 Deadhaven 帮 Gideon 的款——回乡须先挣信任
facts.anchor: Over the last week, she’d been secretly stuffing valuables from her bedchamber into a rucksack

facts.fact: 食堂谈判：她话痨轰击（椅子/马匹/牛肉酥/臭靴子），王子当场投降
facts.anchor: Prince Walder stood in a huff.

facts.fact: 桌上写着 Tolanaa（死国）的卷宗被王子一掌盖死——疑云挂号
facts.anchor: A scroll caught her eye, and she could not help but frown. “Tolanaa?”

facts.fact: 借龙耳偷听：Na-Ri 面前只有面包卷，Larissa 连吃都不许、逼她顺从
facts.anchor: “...huh? Did I say you could eat?”

facts.fact: 王子被她逼出微笑： radiant/warm/captivating——她第一次承认他好看
同桌邀约成功：Na-Ri 挣扎后回以微笑，请他们坐下
